description_en: Deletes endpoints from a custom routing listener
description_zh: 调用DeleteCustomRoutingEndpoints接口删除自定义路由类型监听的终端节点
kebab_example: aliyun ga delete-custom-routing-endpoints --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --endpoint-group-id epg-bp1bpn0kn908w4nb0000 --endpoint-ids ep-bp1dmlohjjz4kqaun0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteCustomRoutingEndpoints

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the GA instance. Set the value to cn-hangzhou
parameters.help_zh: 全球加速实例所在的地域ID，仅取值cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among all requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the request ID as the client token. The request ID may be different for each request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the endpoint group to which the endpoint that you want to delete belongs
parameters.help_zh: 待删除终端节点的终端节点组ID
parameters.name: endpoint_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of endpoints to be deleted.

If you do not set this parameter, all the endpoints in the specified endpoint group are deleted.

You can specify at most 10 endpoint IDs
parameters.help_zh:
待删除的终端节点ID列表。

输入为空时，删除当前终端节点组下所有的终端节点。

您最多可以输入10个终端节点ID
parameters.name: endpoint_ids
